body.p: After . Owns src/xslt_pattern.c, tests/xslt_pattern_test.c. CST of grammars/xslt_pattern to AST to match functions (the IR example of src/ir_internal.h): path patterns, predicate patterns .[…], type patterns, union/intersect/except, rooted patterns ($v, doc, id, key, element-with-id), JNode patterns; default priorities; XTSE0340. Done when the 19,168 parsable patterns of the suite lower and 40 hand-picked patterns match a fixed document as a table says. Spec: XSLT 4.0 "Patterns", "Default Priority for Template Rules". Done 2026-10-17 (): src/xslt_pattern.c, src/xslt_pattern_internal.h, tests/xslt_pattern_test.c; pattern kinds appended to src/xpath_ast_internal.h. 19,288 suite patterns parse and build match expressions, 18,916 lower without stylesheet context; 51 patterns match the fixed document as the table says.
